facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack took the cow. He met a man. The man had beans. Jack traded the cow.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack walked on the road with the old cow. He met a strange old man. The man showed some beans in his hand. Jack liked the beans. Jack traded the cow.
facts.Word cards: trade = 바꾸다 / cow = 소 / stranger = 낯선 사람 / bean = 콩
